title: Optimistic Version Guard
intent: Reject stale writers before they overwrite newer durable state.
problem: Without compare-and-swap rejects an unexpected aggregate version, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the optimistic version guard contract.
context: This pattern addresses concurrent reviewers update one aggregate; its concrete control is compare-and-swap rejects an unexpected aggregate version.
forces: Correctness requires that each successful mutation increments once
Operational pressure can cause: two writers share the same accepted version
solution: Implement compare-and-swap rejects an unexpected aggregate version. Verify the anchored symbol `DurableStoreError` with `test_persists_and_reopens_without_raw_material` before reuse.
invariants: stale expected versions produce no write
failure_modes: two writers share the same accepted version
retry code hides a genuine conflict
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `two writers share the same accepted version` and fails closed if the optimistic version guard evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For optimistic version guard, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to compare-and-swap rejects an unexpected aggregate version.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: concurrent reviewers update one aggregate
Do not apply when: the database operation is append-only and commutative
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
not_when: the database operation is append-only and commutative
